title: About Interasis AI
summary: We are a Brazilian technology company focused on applied artificial intelligence and modern software engineering.

whoWeAre.heading: Who we are
whoWeAre.content: Interasis AI was born from the convergence of data science, software engineering, and business vision. We operate at the intersection of applied research and real product delivery.

howWeWork.heading: How we work
howWeWork.content: We work with agile methodologies, scalable cloud architectures, and modern stacks such as Next.js, NestJS, and Python.

commitment.heading: Commitment
commitment.content: We are committed to transparency, realistic timelines, and quality code. Each project is treated as a long-term partnership.
